info.title: AI Look Virtual Try-On

tags.name: V1.0
tags.description: Generate virtual try-on experiences for full looks from uploaded images using AI processing.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return in this page. Valid value should be between 1 and 20. Default 20.

parameters.name: starting_token
parameters.description: Token for current page. Start with `null` for the first page, and use `next_token` from the previous response to start next page

post.summary: Run an AI Look Virtual Try On task.
post.description: This endpoint initiates the look virtual try-on process using a template and source image. The task will be processed asynchronously, and you can check its status using the task_id returned in this response.

get.summary: Check the status of a AI Look Virtual Try On task.

200.description: Successful check of the task status

BearerAuthenticationV2.description: Use the standard 'Bearer authentication'. Put your 'API Key' in header: `Authorization:Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`. Notice that there is ' ' a space between 'Bearer' and the 'YOUR_API_KEY'.

EngineErrorCode.description:
Errors:

- `exceed_max_filesize` - Input file size exceeds the maximum limit

- `invalid_parameter` - Invalid parameter value

- `error_download_image` - Download source image error

- `error_decode_image` - Decode source image error

- `unknown_internal_error` - Others

content_type.description: Content MIME type for this file. Currently available values are listed in the enum.

file_size.description: Content length for this file in bytes. Should not be larger than 10MB.

content_type.description: Content MIME type for this file.

file_id.description: ID of this file. Other run task API will need this `file_id`.

requests.description: Using upload `url`, `headers`, `method` below to upload file. After completion, the `file_id` is used to proceed with calling run task API.

headers.description: Headers to include when uploading the file

method.description: HTTP method to upload this file

BasicRunTaskV2SrcFileUrl.title: Run task with src file url

src_file_url.description: Url of the file to run task. The url should be publicly accessible.

BasicRunTaskV2SrcFileId.title: Run task with src file ID

src_file_id.description: ID of file to run task. File ID from upload file API.

template_id.description: ID of the template. List predefined templates first, and use the id of a template.

task_id.description: ID of this task. Task result is valid to query by this ID for 24 hours.

url.description: URL to download this result. Valid for 2 hours

id.description: The ID of the template. Use this as `template_id` when run task.

category_name.description: The category name of the template.

style_group_id.description: The id of style group. Use this as `style_group_id` when run task.

style_id.description: The id of style. Use this as `style_ids` when run task.

styles.description: The styles belong to this category.

id.description: The id of sub-category. Use this id to query for its content.
